verified_behavior: Authorized admission uses one immediate SQLite transaction; accepted requests create one durable job without fabricating an executing workflow.
Request ID retries replay the original admission; payload/principal conflicts reject. Rejected joins retain their original result after policy changes.
Joining preserves provider and merge ceiling. A PR observer cannot downgrade merge-enabled work; a merged observer cannot upgrade PR-only work.
Existing PR aliases join their original workflow. Late conflicting aliases hold rather than bypass the submitted policy.
PR-only policy is checked inside both merge reservation and dispatch transactions; all other merge guards remain required.

final_cli_suite.includes: Subprocess exits after durable enqueue before returning a result; retry replays the original admission with one job and one request record.

limits: Caller and remote-target authorization remain obligations of the not-yet-connected CLI/Discord adapters.
The durable queue is not yet consumed by targeted execution; no new run command is exposed by this change.
Work-once, wait, pause, cancel, resume, model changes and delivery controls remain to be connected. See the builder-pin follow-up for execution enforcement.
Late alias conflicts preserve state and require explicit resolution; automatic handoff is not implemented here.
No production rollout, real GitHub mutation, native model call or Discord delivery occurred in these tests.

followup.status: Stored pins are now enforced by existing fresh/resumed/adopted execution; targeted CLI/Discord dispatch remains unconnected.
